name: New Tab Studio
description: Fully customizable new tab: backgrounds, soundtrack, Spotify volume control, launchpad, weather, countdown, and draggable/resizable widgets.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' https://open.spotify.com; object-src 'self'; frame-src https://open.spotify.com https://*.spotify.com; connect-src 'self' https://open.spotify.com https://*.spotify.com https://*.scdn.co https://*.spotifycdn.com; img-src 'self' https: data: blob:;
